name: lua_momentum
author: BlitzkriegBot
description: Official Lua example (E30/issue 336), narrowed to its one live-positive leg, with configurable exits. The unmanaged live window (2026-10-24→26) split the legs: buying the DOWN leg while its own price crashed filled 44 trades at WR 56.8% net +$22.79 (the 0.20-0.35 entry band filled at WR 75%), while chasing the UP leg filled 40 trades at WR 7.5% net -$40.37 (the 17 fills at 0.40+ all lost) — the up leg is deleted and cannot be re-armed by any tunable. Entries are pure maker (issue 742's entry_maker declaration): each entry rests post-only at the falling DOWN leg's best_bid under the never-escalate clock. Exits are strategy signals judged on the fresh best bid after a taker fee (official 0.07*p*(1-p); a zero PolySim schedule does not zero the model): take_profit_pct (default 40), optional take_profit_price, a trailing stop that arms after trail_arm_pct (default 20) and sells on trail_giveback_pct percentage points of giveback (default 15), and an optional exit_time_left_sec deadline (default 0 = off). A position that hits none of them still holds to settlement. allow_both_sides defaults to 0: the opposite token of the same condition is not bought, even though holds_to_settlement would waive the kernel's one-per-asset gate.
